name: comp-299
title: Sonner Toast Trigger
blurb: Trigger button for Sonner toast with message and undo action.
description: Button that programmatically triggers a Sonner toast notification with a completion message, description, and undo action handler.
use_when: You need to display system notifications using the Sonner toast library with action callbacks.
avoid_when: For static, persistent notifications; use a standard card component instead.
a11y: Button is keyboard accessible. Toast respects prefers-reduced-motion if Sonner is configured.
